verdict.rationale: Bevy ships versioned releases on crates.io (0.19.1) and publishes per-release migration guides. However, it is pre-1.0 with breaking changes every release, and the evidence documents no formal deprecation policy. Community reports confirm that upgrades regularly require code changes. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation policy or timeline, API stability guarantees (post-1.0 semver stability), deprecation warnings or support windows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: bevy = "0.19.1" # A refreshingly simple data-driven game engine and app framework
Every Bevy update brings new functionality and improvements. Follow these guides to migrate your project to the latest Bevy has to offer!
Pre-1.0 with breaking changes each release — a real caveat for agents trained on older APIs.
